paragraphs: I am Lily, and I am in Teacher Kim's class. Every week, Teacher Kim puts our timetable online. Dad reads it on the laptop in the evening. Today I show him the days and the times. The timetable has five days, and each lesson has a time. "Which lesson do you like best?" asks Dad. "I like art," I say. "We have it on Wednesday at one o'clock."

On Monday, our first lesson is math at half past eight. Math is hard for me, but Mia helps me. At a quarter to eleven, we have music. We eat lunch at twelve o'clock. Then we play on the school field. On Tuesday, we go to the library at ten o'clock. We borrow a book once a week. I always borrow a book about animals. Mia borrows a story book. The library is bright and quiet.

On Wednesday, we have art at one o'clock. We paint pictures of our families. I paint Pip with his red ball. On Thursday, we have English at nine o'clock. On Friday, we have a cook lesson at half past one. We cook rice with vegetables, and we eat it together. We wash our hands first. Teacher Kim shows us how to cut the vegetables. We have a very good time. School finishes at three o'clock every day.

"What do we have in summer?" asks Dad. "We have a new timetable," I say. "It has swimming once a week." Dad smiles and reads the timetable again. Summer is hot, so the pool is fun. "I like your Friday lesson," he says. "Please cook for us at home!" I laugh and say, "Yes, Dad!"
